name: io.github.thyn-ai/sqai
title: SQAI — deterministic, read-only structured data
description: SQAI (Structured Query AI) as an MCP server: three governed tools — listSources (discovery), queryData (deterministic read-only queries + computation with plan_hash/result_id provenance), explainQuery (dry-run plan validation). Zero-config introspection: initialize and tools/list answer with no credentials; sources connect lazily on first call.

environmentVariables.name: SQAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for licensing / API mode (semantics owned by @thyn-ai/sqai). Optional: zero-config local mode needs no key for introspection and queries.

environmentVariables.name: SQAI_DEPLOYMENT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Private deployment endpoint; selects deployment mode when present. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: SQAI_SOURCES
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of SqaiSourceInput (path/URL string, array of row objects, or { "data": …, "name": "…" }). Sources connect lazily on the first tool call. Optional.
